title: Law to ban ads for unregistered e-bikes and mopeds
summary: This bill would prohibit advertising for sale, lease, rent or distribution of any vehicle that must be registered with the state Department of Motor Vehicles but resembles a street-legal e-bike or e-scooter, such as oversized or throttle mopeds. Ads for vehicles that look like e-bikes or e-scooters but actually require DMV registration would have to clearly say so. It also requires the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and Department of Transportation to create informational materials for retailers and run a public outreach campaign on which devices are legal to ride on city streets, with the law taking effect 180 days after passage.
